name: Kokan Hunter 4 ~OL Manji Katame~
source:
The first crotch hunter in history becomes a salary-man. He is anxious to improve the management of the company and hunt for office lady crotches at the same time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
史上第一位胯下獵人成了一名上班族。他既迫切希望改善公司的經營狀況，也想同時狩獵女上班族的胯下。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
